categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Organise the storefront tree — drag a row to move or reorder it (Undo is always offered). On a phone, use Edit.
categories.editConflict: This category was changed elsewhere — the list has been refreshed. Reopen it to try again.

tree.orphanHint: This category’s parent isn’t in the current list — it’s shown at the top level.

categories.restoreMessage: “{name}” will be moved back to the live tree.
categories.restoreMessageWithChildren: “{name}” and {count, plural, one {# archived sub-category} other {# archived sub-categories}} will be moved back to the live tree.

toast.moved: {count, plural, =0 {Category “{name}” moved.} one {Category “{name}” moved (+# sub-category).} other {Category “{name}” moved (+# sub-categories).}}

form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
form.slugChangeWarning: Changing the slug breaks existing links to this category — a redirect is not set up automatically.
form.name: Name (English)

err.nameLong: Keep the name to 200 characters or fewer.
err.slugLong: Keep the slug to 80 characters or fewer.
err.slugFormat: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens only.
err.slugReserved: That word is reserved — pick a different slug.

brands.title: Brands
brands.subtitle: The shared brand list products pick from. Delete relinks any of its products to no brand; Merge preserves the brand identity by relinking them to a survivor instead.
brands.restrictedHint: Counterfeit-prone — new listings under this brand need extra verification.
brands.restoreMessage: “{name}” will be moved back to the live list.
brands.editConflict: This brand was changed elsewhere — the list has been refreshed. Reopen it to try again.

form.name: Name
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Left blank on create, it’s derived from the name.
form.displayNameHint: Optional — shown to buyers instead of the canonical name. Leave blank to use the name as-is.
form.isRestrictedHint: Independent of status — an active brand can also be restricted.
form.logoKeyHint: An object-storage key, not a file — upload isn’t built yet.
form.aliasesHint: Alternate spellings that resolve to this brand (e.g. “JBL”, “jbl”, “JBL Audio”).

err.nameLong: Keep the name to 120 characters or fewer.
err.slugLong: Keep the slug to 80 characters or fewer.
err.slugFormat: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens only.
err.logoKeyLong: Keep the logo key to 500 characters or fewer.

mergeDialog.title: Merge “{name}” into…
mergeDialog.description: Its aliases and any products move to the target; its own name becomes an alias of the target. “{name}” is archived and kept for audit/redirects.

optionTypes.title: Option types
optionTypes.subtitle: Reusable choice axes (Color, Size, Material…) that categories and products pick from.
optionTypes.noMatch: No option types match your search.
optionTypes.restoreMessage: “{name}” will be moved back to the live list.
optionTypes.editConflict: This option type was changed elsewhere — the list has been refreshed. Reopen it to try again.

form.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and single - or _ — used internally, not shown to buyers.
form.name: Name (English)
form.hasSwatchHint: Each value can carry a color swatch (e.g. for Color).
form.valuesHint: The choices buyers/sellers pick from for this option.

err.codeFormat: Lowercase letters, digits and single - or _ only.
err.codeLong: Keep the code to 60 characters or fewer.
err.nameLong: Keep the name to 120 characters or fewer.

errors.categorySlugTaken: That slug is already in use by another category.
errors.categoryNameTaken: Another category already has that name (names are case-insensitive).
errors.categoryParentInvalid: The chosen parent category was not found.
errors.categoryParentArchived: That category’s parent is archived — restore the parent first.
errors.categoryHasChildren: Move or delete the child categories first.
errors.categoryCycle: A category cannot be moved under its own descendant.
errors.brandSlugTaken: That brand slug is already in use.
errors.brandNameTaken: A brand with that name already exists (names are case-insensitive).
errors.brandAliasTaken: That alias already maps to a brand.
errors.brandMergeInvalid: That merge isn’t possible — check that both brands are still live and distinct.
errors.optionTypeCodeTaken: That code is already in use by another option type.

errors.conflict: That action conflicts with the current state — reload and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.offline: You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
